name: CoolerControl
description: CoolerControl is a feature-rich fan and RGB control and monitoring application for Linux. Visit https://docs.coolercontrol.org/installation/Unraid.html for information on setting this container up properly. You may encounter issues setting up this container on Unraid versions below 7.0.1.

paths.name: CoolerControl configuration
paths.description: This is where configuration files are stored for CoolerControl. This allows settings to persist.

paths.name: HWMon
paths.description: This exposes your hardware sensors to CoolerControl with read-only access.

ports.name: WebUI port
ports.description: This port is where the CoolerControl WebUI can be accessed.

variables.name: CoolerControl Port
variables.description: The port that the container will expose CoolerControl on. You probably do not need to change this.

variables.name: CoolerControl IPv4 address
variables.description: The IPv4 address that the container will expose CoolerControl on. You probably do not need to change this.

variables.name: CoolerControl IPv6 address
variables.description: The IPv6 address that the container will expose CoolerControl on. You probably do not need to change this.

variables.name: CoolerControl DBUS
variables.description: This tells CoolerControl you are running in Docker and it can ignore a DBUS error. You probably do not need to change this.
